prerequisites.title: X developer account, Project and App
prerequisites.detail: You need a developer account, a Project in the developer portal, and an App that holds the credentials. Turn on OAuth 2.0 in the App's authentication settings.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms of service
prerequisites.detail: Link both in the developer dashboard before applying for write scopes.

prerequisites.title: Funded API credits
prerequisites.detail: Pay-per-use is credit-based. Plan a payment card.

steps.title: Create developer account, Project and App
steps.detail: Sign up at the X developer portal and create a Project and an App. Turn on OAuth 2.0 in the App's authentication settings.
steps.done_when: The App shows a client ID and secret with OAuth 2.0 on.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Copy the callback URL from the Composio dashboard and add it exactly to the App's callback settings in the developer portal. It must be HTTPS in production and match exactly, including any trailing slash.
steps.done_when: The callback URL is saved in the X app settings.

steps.title: Link privacy policy and terms
steps.detail: Add both links in the developer dashboard.
steps.done_when: Both links show in the dashboard.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications
steps.detail: Write a clear explanation of why each write or DM scope is needed. Start with read-only scopes and expand later.
steps.done_when: A justification exists for every requested scope.

steps.title: Include offline.access scope
steps.detail: Request offline.access so a refresh token is issued. Without it the access token expires after two hours.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and returns an ID.

steps.title: Wait for any security review
steps.detail: If X triggers a review for write or DM scopes, wait for the result. Duration is not documented.
steps.done_when: X lets the write or DM scopes work for outside users.

traps.title: Regenerating the client secret breaks refresh
traps.detail: A client secret regenerated in the developer portal can cause refresh to fail. Update the Composio auth config if you rotate it.

traps.title: Missing offline.access means two-hour tokens
traps.detail: Without this scope no refresh token is issued, and the access token dies after two hours.

traps.title: Callback URL must match exactly
traps.detail: Protocol, slashes and trailing slash must all match. Production must use HTTPS.

traps.title: Skipping review requirements
traps.detail: Skipping the listed requirements may cause delays or outright rejection during app review.

traps.title: Consent comes from the connecting account
traps.detail: With OAuth 2.0 the connecting account itself must log in and consent. No customer admin approval was found.

blockers.what_it_means: Elevated access may be required for some scopes.
blockers.what_to_do: Apply for Elevated access or re-check the requested permissions.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes against what the app is approved for and suggest a smaller set.
